title: Sharp finite-matrix Lieb–Thirring inequalities and all equality cases

result.label: Sharp finite-matrix Lieb–Thirring inequalities and all equality cases
result.statement: Proves the sharp one-dimensional Lieb–Thirring inequality for 1/2 3/2 and arbitrary finite-matrix potentials W ≥ 0 with tr (W^ +1/2 ) : the optimal constant is the scalar one-bound-state value, independent of matrix size. All equality cases are direct sums, in one constant unitary basis, of scalar sech 2 solitons with independent scales and centers, and zero channels.
